row.evidence: AlertMedia's pricing page says it 'uses custom pricing to build the perfect plan for every customer' with no tier table; Okta's and Microsoft's catalogues list AlertMedia apps with SCIM provisioning, but AlertMedia's own docs sit behind a login, so the plan gate is not public.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only pricing (request form, no tiers). SCIM exists: Okta OIN app (SAML + SCIM; Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking) and Entra gallery app with a provisioning tutorial (long-lived bearer token from Company > API; users and groups; AlertMedia custom-attribute schema extension). Which plan includes SSO or SCIM is not published, so status is unknown. Help centre and developer docs require login; Microsoft's SSO page says JIT is on by default.

plans.name: Custom plan (quote only)
plans.notes: Pricing page lists 'What's Always Included' items (e.g. 'Simplified User & Data Management') and integration logos (Azure Active Directory, Okta, Workday, ADP) but no plan features for SSO or SCIM.

scim.notes: SCIM evidence comes only from IdP pages: Okta's OIN app (markup checks SAML and SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking; updated Dec 5 2024) and Microsoft's Entra provisioning tutorial (long-lived bearer token = Client Token from AlertMedia Company > API > Add New; users and groups; maps userName, active and urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:alertmedia:2.0:CustomAttribute:User attributes such as first_name, last_name, email, email2, email3, title, mobile_phone(2,3) with post-dial, home_phone, office_phone, address, address2, city, state, zipcode, country, customer_user_id, user_type, notes; groups displayName and members). Kept out of the vendor-docs fields because AlertMedia's help centre and developer docs require a login.

user_api.notes: docs.alertmedia.com is password protected and the support centre requires a login; Microsoft's tutorial mentions AlertMedia 'API Integration' keys under Company > API, but no public API reference was found.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking. Builder not stated.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SAML SSO (IdP-initiated; JIT enabled by default per Microsoft) and SCIM provisioning of users and groups.

onelogin.notes: Not checked (OneLogin connector pages block bots; AlertMedia's own guides are behind login).

fallbacks.notes: support.alertmedia.com (Zendesk) rejects anonymous API search ('Couldn't authenticate you') and docs.alertmedia.com redirects to a password page. Microsoft's SSO tutorial says AlertMedia supports JIT provisioning enabled by default (IdP page, not recorded as a vendor fact).
